# Lumia Stream triggers

## Alert

Runs when Lumia Stream shows an alert, like a new follower. Good for adding your own reaction.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Alerts** | Only run for these alerts, like "twitch-follower", separated by commas. Leave empty for any alert. |
| **Replays** | Include runs for every alert. Ignore skips alerts that are being shown again. Only runs just for alerts being shown again. Options: Include, Ignore, Only. Starts as: `Include`. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%lumia.alert%` | The alert's name |
| `%lumia.replay%` | True if this alert is shown again |
| `%user%` | Who it was about, if known |
| `%lumia.origin%` | Which site it came from |

<small>Type id: `lumia.alert`</small>

## Chat message

Runs when Lumia Stream sees a chat message. Handy to react in your lights or overlays.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Platforms** | Only run for these chat sites, like "twitch, youtube, kick", separated by commas. Leave empty for all of them. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%user%` | Who wrote it |
| `%message%` | What they wrote |
| `%messageId%` | The message's id |
| `%lumia.origin%` | Which site it came from |

<small>Type id: `lumia.chatMessage`</small>

## Chat message deleted

Runs when Lumia Stream sees a chat message get deleted.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Platforms** | Only run for these chat sites, like "twitch, youtube, kick", separated by commas. Leave empty for all of them. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%messageId%` | The deleted message's id |
| `%lumia.origin%` | Which site it came from |

<small>Type id: `lumia.chatMessageDeleted`</small>

## Command used

Runs when a chat command is used that Lumia Stream knows about.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Commands** | Only run for these commands, typed without the ! and separated by commas. Leave empty for any command. |
| **Platforms** | Only run for these chat sites, like "twitch, youtube, kick", separated by commas. Leave empty for all of them. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%command%` | The command that was used |
| `%user%` | Who used it |
| `%lumia.origin%` | Which site it came from |

<small>Type id: `lumia.command`</small>

## Connected

Runs when Cuebot connects to Lumia Stream. Handy for a quick "all good" message or to switch something on.

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%service%` | The name of the service |

<small>Type id: `lumia.connected`</small>

## Disconnected

Runs when Cuebot loses or ends its connection to Lumia Stream. Handy to warn yourself that alerts have stopped.

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%service%` | The name of the service |
| `%reason%` | Why the connection ended |

<small>Type id: `lumia.disconnected`</small>

## Other event

Runs for other messages Lumia Stream sends that have no trigger of their own.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Event types** | Only run for these kinds of message, like "premium", separated by commas. Leave empty for any. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%lumia.type%` | The kind of message |
| `%lumia.data%` | The full message, as text |

<small>Type id: `lumia.event`</small>

## States changed

Runs when Lumia Stream turns on or off, or its stream mode switches.

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%lumia.on%` | True if Lumia is on |
| `%lumia.streamMode%` | True if stream mode is on |

<small>Type id: `lumia.statesChanged`</small>
